name: handoff
description: Handoff: a hosted MCP service that carries a prepared brief and original attachments from one AI assistant to another.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:playground: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.playground.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.playground.jsonc

DB.description: D1 database for packets, attachment records, members, sign-ins and console activity. Created for you.

BLOBS.description: R2 bucket for the original files sent with a packet (PDF, PNG, JPEG, Markdown, plain text). Created for you.

HANDOFF_SETUP_CODE.description: A code you choose, 12 characters or more (for example from `openssl rand -base64 18`). After deploying, open `/console/setup` on your Worker and enter it to become the admin. It works only while no admin exists.
